comment: The catch-all rewrite sends every path to the SPA, because the app routes
on the client and a deep link must not 404. It used to match /api too, so
every API call on the deployed site was answered with index.html and the
app saw HTML where it expected JSON: no courses, no destinations, nothing.
The negative lookahead keeps /api out of it.
To put the API on the same origin as the site, which is what the httpOnly
refresh cookie needs, add a rewrite ABOVE the catch-all pointing at the
Without that proxy the site and the API are separate origins, so set
VITE_API_URL to the backend URL and REFRESH_COOKIE_SAMESITE=None on the
backend, or the session is lost on every reload.
